summary.text: Steve Fitzpatrick is a Republican state representative from Montana who has represented House District 24 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, he served in the Montana House from 2011 to 2017 and in the Montana Senate from 2017 to 2025, where he was majority leader.

paragraphs.text: Steve Fitzpatrick earned a bachelor's degree from Montana State University and a law degree from Arizona State University, and his career experience includes working as an attorney.
Fitzpatrick served in the Montana House of Representatives, District 20, from 2011 to 2017, and then in the Montana State Senate, District 10, from 2017 to 2025.
He won re-election to the Senate in 2020 and served as Senate majority leader from 2023 until January 2025, when he was elected House majority leader.
He won the House District 24 general election on November 5, 2024, and assumed office on January 6, 2025.
In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the House Rules Committee and is assigned to the Local Government, Natural Resources, Taxation, and Business and Labor committees.
